headline: Operational beat, guidance raised; earnings swing on hedges
summary_short: EQT beat its own Q2 volume, capex, and cost guidance, and raised full-year 2026 production guidance by ~90 Bcfe, but GAAP net income of $211.4M (EPS $0.34) fell 73% y/y as a $45M derivatives gain in Q2 2026 replaced a $720M gain in Q2 2025; adjusted EPS was $0.39, down just $0.06 y/y.
summary_long: Volume of 634 Bcfe beat guidance's high end; capex of $666M came in 9% below the low end, and per-unit costs of $1.03/Mcfe hit the low end of guidance. Adjusted EPS was $0.39, down $0.06 y/y; GAAP EPS of $0.34 (net income $211.4M) fell $0.96 y/y almost entirely because derivatives mark-to-market swung from a $720M gain in Q2 2025 to $45M in Q2 2026. Free cash flow attributable to EQT was $330M. EQT raised full-year 2026 production guidance ~90 Bcfe and cut full-year capex guidance $25M. Total debt fell to $5.7B from $7.8B at 2025 year-end after $2.1B repaid; cash was $112.9M.

drivers.explanation: GAAP net income and EPS fell y/y mainly because Q2 2025 booked a $720M derivatives mark-to-market gain vs $45M in Q2 2026; adjusted EPS (ex-derivatives) fell only $0.06 y/y to $0.39.

Underlying gas/NGL/oil sales of $1.61B were down modestly y/y on lower realized gas pricing; the large q/q and y/y swings in total revenue are driven mainly by the volatile derivatives mark-to-market line.

Total operating expenses were nearly flat y/y ($1,416M vs $1,424M); the operating income decline is explained almost entirely by the derivatives gain shrinking from $720M to $45M within total revenue.
Transportation and processing costs eased slightly as processing expense per Mcfe fell y/y on higher sales volume and less gas requiring processing.
Total debt fell to $5.7B from $7.8B at 2025 year-end after $2.1B of debt repayment during H1 2026, including $115M of 2026 debentures repaid just after quarter-end.
Cash fell as financing outflows for debt repayment, dividends, and noncontrolling-interest distributions exceeded operating cash flow after investing outflows.
